# پت‌دیت (PetDate)

> پت‌دیت پلتفرم فارسی پیدا کردن همبازی برای پت، پت‌شاپ، پذیرش پت و مشاوره دامپزشک است — روی وب و ربات تلگرام با یک حساب مشترک.

- Website: [https://petdate.ir/](https://petdate.ir/)
- Contact: [hello@petdate.ir](mailto:hello@petdate.ir)
- Telegram bot: [https://t.me/Petdatebot](https://t.me/Petdatebot)

## What PetDate is

PetDate (پت‌دیت) helps pet owners in Iran:
- Find playmates (همبازی) for dogs and cats
- Browse and buy from the pet shop (پت‌شاپ)
- Discover pets available for adoption (پذیرش)
- Request online veterinary consultation (مشاوره دامپزشک)

Web and Telegram share the same account (OTP login by mobile number).

## Key URLs

- [Home / landing](https://petdate.ir/)
- [FAQ](https://petdate.ir/faq)
- [Pet shop](https://petdate.ir/shop)
- [Vet consult](https://petdate.ir/vet-consult)
- [Adoption examples](https://petdate.ir/adoption/missy)
- [Login](https://petdate.ir/auth/login)
- [Sitemap](https://petdate.ir/sitemap.xml)
- [Full AI summary](https://petdate.ir/llms-full.txt)

Playmate panel (`/chats`) requires login — not a primary crawl target.

## Brand

- Persian name: پت‌دیت
- English: PetDate / petdate / PET DATE
- Tagline (FA): همبازی برای پت‌ات
- Tagline (EN): PLAY • MEET • FRIENDS
- Domain: petdate.ir

## Notes for crawlers

- Primary language: Persian (fa), RTL UI
- Public pages: landing, FAQ, shop (browse). Playmate panel, chat, and checkout require login.
- Do not describe PetDate as a clinic directory; clinic listings were removed. Veterinary support is online consultation, not a clinic marketplace.
